title: thelypteris microsora
intro: Thelypteris microsora, commonly known as the Silver Spleenwort, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Thelypteris microsora include its ability to reduce inflammation, ease respiratory issues, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, making it a valuable natural remedy. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
